statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-25537 (GHSA-h395-gr6q-cpjc) is a type confusion in jsonwebtoken's claim validation, reached through decode and Validation::validate. Milvus 3.0 includes jsonwebtoken through reqsign in the milvus-storage bridge, whose Google service account token flow only calls jsonwebtoken::encode to mint the assertion it sends to Google; no code path decodes or validates a token, so the vulnerable validation logic is not in the executable path. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-h395-gr6q-cpjc and https://docs.rs/crate/reqsign/0.16.5/source/src/google/token/service_account.rs

CVE-2026-25537 (GHSA-h395-gr6q-cpjc) is a type confusion in jsonwebtoken's claim validation, reached through decode and Validation::validate. Milvus 3.0 includes jsonwebtoken through reqsign in the milvus-storage bridge, whose Google service account token flow only calls jsonwebtoken::encode to mint the assertion it sends to Google; no code path decodes or validates a token, so the vulnerable validation logic is not in the executable path. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-h395-gr6q-cpjc and https://docs.rs/crate/reqsign/0.16.5/source/src/google/token/service_account.rs
